{{Quote|The Star Destroyer is incapable of hyperspace travel and the shields on its port side are not functioning due to a timing flaw in the sublight drives. If we are to attack at all, we must do so now.|K-M2|<ref name="GG6-1" />}}
'''K-M2''' or '''Kay-Emtoo''' was an [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[K-Series spaceport control droid]]. Painted bright red, he was a 2 meter tall, awkward looking droid with a dome shaped cranium.<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Biography==
K-M2 was the result of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] experiment to infiltrate droids into key points within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Specially equipped with backup power batteries and memory storage units to avoid [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]], he was placed by the Rebels at an out-of-the-way Imperial base. He eventually rose to be in charge of [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] control on [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]], in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Personality and traits==
K-M2 was surprisingly compassionate and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Programmer/Legends|programmers]] were concerned he would one day sacrifice his excellent [[Spy/Legends|spy]] position to save an endangered being. He was also very committed to the Rebellion and despite his success in the isolated [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] he wanted to resume contact with his Rebel handlers to provide current information about [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Despite regular [[K-Series spaceport control droid|K-Series spaceport control droids]] being always presented as 2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall in [[West End Games]]' [[The Star Wars Sourcebook]], K-M2 was listed as being just 1.7 meters  tall in [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]], with no mention of it being painted bright red.
